title: selfcheck's orphans check tells a session-end distill run still at work from a stuck one, instead of failing on any past HOOK_GRACE_S
goal: backlog.py selfcheck failed its orphans check at the start of the SP-ajcomz6d run on two querylog.py distill --settle 2 processes of other sessions' ends (parent pid 1, 1 min 32 s old), which finished on their own minutes later; bl_procs.HOOK_GRACE_S (60 s) is shorter than a distill of a long orchestrator transcript. The orphans check fails only on a distill run that is stuck, read from its own progress or lock rather than a fixed 60 s, so an orchestrator acts on no false failure (found by the SP-ajcomz6d close).
notes: SP-qjn563cf run (2026-10-11): selfcheck failed its orphans check again on two python3 processes (pids 32577, 32579) of another session's checkout; procs read 0 orphans 30 minutes later. SP-up5wchen run (2026-10-11): selfcheck failed its orphans check on another session's querylog.py distill --settle 2 (pid 34062, parent 1, 1 min 8 s old).
